subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding silent processing of unmentioned speech changes privacy/security and configuration policy rather than only fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Defer until a broader media-history policy exists
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input but avoid adding a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should never be transcribed or retained without a direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history makes steipete the strongest available routing candidate for a Discord preflight/config policy decision, though the final call is product/security-oriented.
